items.title: 68516_Gene Ramey oral history interview
items.q: They were talking about supplying me, furnishing me, backing me to have a big band and rehearse with them.

ctx.x: In 1949 Teddy Reig wanted you to form a trio?
Yeah. No, a band. They were talking about supplying me, furnishing me, backing me to have a big band and rehearse with them.
Well, what did you give as your reason for not --
